reason: In scheduleSMSReminders.ts:189-198 the catch block awaits prisma.workflowReminder.update with no guard, before the console.log. If that update fails, for example with P2025 because the row was deleted concurrently (the same failure that sends control into the catch from the update at :169), the error escapes the for loop at :67, so the remaining reminders, the error log and the 200 response at :201 are all skipped. One detail of the claim is wrong: the earlier deleteMany (:29) runs before findMany (:48), so it cannot delete rows the loop has already fetched.
